name: passing_setup_straight_hit
description: 2v2. Blue car 0 drives at 1400 uu/s into a resting ball and hits it up-field toward open space; the blue mate and both orange cars idle. One touch, so one payment, then the 0.5 s cooldown. The reward's tiers cap a payment at 2.0 (primary) + 1.5 (clean lob) + about 0.6 (zone) = about 4.1.

expect.intent: one clean hit is one payment
the payment starts the anti-farm cooldown exactly once
a payment sits between a fraction of, and the full sum of, the reward's tiers (at most about 4.1)
the car touches the ball at least once
an orange car that never touches the ball earns nothing
